finalText:
**Redis died, and everything else fell over behind it.**

Here's the chain:

```
02:14:07  redis refuses connections (10.0.0.12:6379)
       ↓  cache off, every read hits the store
02:14:10  store overloads, 5s timeouts start
       ↓  queue grows 52 → 568 over 17 min
02:31:44  worker-2 runs out of memory
02:31:52  supervisor kills api — service down
```

Redis never came back. All 13 reconnect tries got `ECONNREFUSED`, the last at 02:31:26.

The last request that worked was at 02:14:03. After that the log is only errors, so you were fully down for roughly 18 minutes before the kill.

Two things worth fixing. The queue cap of 500 was never enforced, it reached 568. And losing the cache took the whole service with it.
